tool.name: OpenSwathPercolatorScoring
tool.description: Rescore OpenSWATH OSW / OSWPQ results with in-process Percolator
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("osw")}' #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("osw")}' '$out' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input OpenSWATH result file (.osw) or OSWPQ parquet archive/directory (.oswpq)
One or more scoring levels to run sequentially
param.help: Use 'ms2 transition' or 'ms1ms2 transition' to derive peak-group and transition scores from an unscored input

param.name: peakgroup_max_rank
param.label: Transition scoring: maximum MS2 peak-group rank retained for transition rescoring

param.name: peakgroup_max_pep
param.label: Transition scoring: maximum MS2 peak-group PEP retained for transition rescoring

param.name: max_isotope_overlap
param.label: Transition scoring: maximum transition isotope-overlap score retained for rescoring

param.name: min_log_sn
param.label: Transition scoring: minimum log signal-to-noise score retained for rescoring

param.name: c_pos
param.label: Positive regularization constant (C+)

param.name: c_neg
param.label: Negative regularization constant (C-)

param.name: test_fdr
param.label: Test FDR threshold for SVM direction selection

param.name: train_fdr
param.label: Training FDR for SVM iterations

param.name: num_iterations
param.label: Number of SVM training iterations

param.name: initial_direction
param.label: Feature name to use as the initial scoring direction
param.help: Prefix with '-' if LOWER values are more target-like (e.g. 'COMET:lnExpect' means higher is better; '-COMET:lnExpect' means lower is better). Leave empty (default) to let Percolator auto-select by testing every feature in both directions and picking the one that separates the most targets at train_fdr

param.name: pep_method
param.label: Posterior error probability estimator: 'logistic_regression' (target-decoy competition + isotonic fit; legacy name, not actually logistic regression), 'isotonic' (target-q → pep monotone regression), or 'nonparametric' (kernel smoothing)

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed for CV splitting

param.name: target_decoy_metavalue
param.label: Meta-value on PeptideHit indicating target/decoy ('target'/'decoy')

param.name: normalizer
param.label: Feature normalizer: 'stdv' (zero-mean, unit-stdv, default), 'uni' (min/max), or 'none' (no normalization)

param.name: train_best_positive
param.label: During TRAINING, use only the best PSM per spectrum as a positive example
param.help: Affects the SVM (weights change). Orthogonal to post_processing_tdc. Default is 'true' because typical OpenMS inputs are multi-hit-per-spectrum (Comet/MSGF+/Sage top-N, OSW peak groups). Inert on one-hit-per-spectrum inputs. Note: the upstream percolator binary defaults this to off — PercolatorAdapter preserves the CLI contract by mirroring its flag state when writing this param

param.name: post_processing_tdc
param.label: AFTER training, before PEP/q-value calculation, apply Target-Decoy Competition: keep only the highest-scoring PSM per (scan, mass, charge) and drop the rest from the score set
param.help: Does NOT touch the SVM — only the score distribution used for FDR. Default is 'true' because without TDC on multi-hit input, q-values count every candidate as an independent 'chance' and drift optimistic. Inert on one-hit-per-spectrum inputs. Note: the upstream percolator binary defaults this to off — PercolatorAdapter preserves the CLI contract by mirroring its flag state when writing this param

param.name: nested_xval_bins
param.label: Number of nested CV bins for grid search of Cpos/Cneg
param.help: Upstream default for cross validation is 3; 1 disables nested search

param.name: subset_max_train
param.label: Cap on the training set size (0 = use all)
param.help: Default 100000 bounds training time on very large inputs (>1M PSMs) at negligible quality loss. Sampling is reservoir-based, keyed by (scan, exp_mass) so all PSMs sharing a spectrum travel together; the trained model is then applied to ALL input rows via a second scoring pass (matches upstream Caller.cpp behavior). Inert when the input size is at or below the cap. Note: upstream percolator binary defaults this to 0 — PercolatorAdapter preserves the CLI contract by passing its own int option (CLI default 0) through to this param

param.name: report_as_main_score
param.label: Which Percolator output to stamp as the main PeptideHit score after rescoring
param.help: 'none' (default) leaves hit.getScore() and the PeptideIdentification score_type untouched — callers who want the original search score preserved (or who run their own post-processing like PercolatorAdapter) rely on this. 'q-value' sets main score to the PSM-level q-value and marks higher_score_better=false. 'pep' sets main score to the PEP and marks higher_score_better=false. 'svm' sets main score to the SVM discriminant and marks higher_score_better=true. All three Percolator outputs remain accessible as percolator_{score,q_value,pep} meta values regardless of this setting

param.name: num_threads
param.label: Number of OpenMP threads for cross-validation (one per CV fold; max useful = 3)

param.name: use_pi0
param.label: Enable pi0 correction when computing q-values and PEPs (default)
param.help: When true, pi0 is estimated per CV fold via bootstrap spline fit on the target score distribution using decoys as the null. When false, pi0 is fixed at 1.0 (pure target-decoy FDR, no bootstrap estimation). Affects both Scores::calcQvals and Scores::calcPep. Upstream percolator has no CLI flag for this; the in-library Scores(bool usePi0) constructor is the only toggle, matched here

param.label: Overrides tool-specific checks
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs

data.name: out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Rescore OpenSWATH OSW / OSWPQ results with in-process Percolator.
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_OpenSwathPercolatorScoring.html
